mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_adjacent_range_overlap_continuity_238p
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Campaign010 compares the prior and current high-low intervals symmetrically and without direction. Campaign015 ignores the current interval, compares only the current close with the previous complete interval, and measures signed accepted escape beyond its boundary.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_global_price_range_revisit_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Campaign014 is invariant to bar order and measures the global union of all high-low intervals. Campaign015 is order-sensitive, forms only within-half prior-range/current-close pairs, and has no global union or revisit calculation.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_body_range_efficiency_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Campaign009 uses current same-bar open and close displacement relative to current range. Campaign015 forbids open, ignores the current range, and uses the previous bar's high-low boundary as a causal reference.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_signed_path_efficiency_239m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Signed path efficiency uses every close-to-close move and net path length. Campaign015 assigns exactly zero to a current close inside the previous full interval and measures only the excess beyond the prior high or low.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_upside_semivariance_share_239m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Upside semivariance divides signed close-return quadratic variation. Campaign015 does not square a return and can change when prior high-low boundaries change while every close is held fixed.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_return_sign_run_imbalance_238p
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Sign-run imbalance counts adjacent return-sign persistence. Campaign015 uses no sign-run pair; a same-sign move inside the prior range contributes zero and an escape magnitude beyond the range boundary contributes continuously.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_terminal_close_location_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Terminal location privileges the final close relative to the day's close extrema. Campaign015 treats all 238 within-half current closes equally and uses only each immediately previous high-low interval.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_transaction_vwap_envelope_asymmetry_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Campaign013 uses same-bar high/low around amount/volume transaction VWAP. Campaign015 uses neither amount, volume, transaction price, nor the current high-low envelope.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Candidate49 counts close crossings around a causal cumulative VWAP. Campaign015 has no activity field, cumulative state, or crossing count and never reads Candidate49 returns.

candidate.name: intraday_prior_range_breakout_pressure_238p
candidate.economic_hypothesis: A larger net magnitude of current closes accepted above the previous minute's complete high-low territory, relative to accepted escapes in either direction, may identify directional price discovery that persists over the next three sessions.
candidate.formula: (U-D)/(U+D), where U=sum(max(log(close_t/high_(t-1)),0)) and D=sum(max(log(low_(t-1)/close_t),0)) across 238 within-half adjacent pairs
formula_steps: Require the exact accepted 241-row source grid, preserve but exclude standalone 09:30, and select exactly the 240 bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00.

Require every selected high, low, and close to be finite and strictly positive, with exact raw ordering low_i <= high_i and low_i <= close_i <= high_i for each selected bar. Do not round, clamp, sort within a bar, repair, or use a price-grid tolerance.

Inside each 120-bar trading half only, form 119 pairs from previous bar i to current bar t=i+1. Morning and afternoon contribute 238 pairs in total. Form no 11:30-to-13:01 lunch pair, 09:30 pair, overnight pair, cross-day pair, or cross-stock pair.

For each pair define u_t=max(log(close_t/high_i),0) and d_t=max(log(low_i/close_t),0). Equality to the prior high or low is inside the closed prior interval and contributes exact zero. Because low_i<=high_i, at most one of u_t and d_t can be positive.

Let U=sum(u_t), D=sum(d_t), and B=U+D across the fixed 238 pairs. Require U, D, and B finite and B strictly positive. No minimum nonzero-breakout count, threshold, tick epsilon, imputation, or substitution is allowed.

Compute q=(U-D)/B. Require q finite and exactly within the closed interval [-1,1]. Return q without clipping, winsorization, smoothing, ranking, count conversion, power transform, or another normalization.
candidate.timestamp_semantics: Use exactly 238 prior-range/current-close pairs: 119 inside the morning half and 119 inside the afternoon half. Exclude 09:30 and the lunch transition.
candidate.zero_missing_denominator_semantics: Every valid current close inside or on the previous closed high-low interval contributes zero. A stock-day with no close beyond any prior interval has B=0 and remains missing. Any invalid/nonpositive/nonfinite input, low-above-high or close-outside-own-bar ordering, nonfinite component, nonpositive denominator, or result outside [-1,1] makes the stock-day missing.
mechanism_distinction_before_values: Holding all 240 closes fixed while widening or narrowing prior high-low intervals can change Campaign015 but leaves close-only return factors unchanged.

Holding all high-low intervals fixed while moving a current close inside versus beyond a prior boundary changes Campaign015 but leaves Campaign010 interval overlap and Campaign014 interval union unchanged.
A large close-to-close move that remains inside the prior interval contributes zero; a smaller move beyond a narrow prior boundary contributes a positive or negative excess.
Campaign015 contains no open, amount, volume, transaction price, market peer, global interval union, cumulative reference, or forward return.
rejected_variants_before_values: breakout counts, binary shares, run counts, first/last breakout, time-since-breakout, maximum breakout, quantiles, powers, signs without magnitude, or a count-weighted denominator
using current high or low, current open, same-bar close location, body, wick, range overlap, containment, gap, Jaccard, union, component, or convex-hull measures
using previous close, current open, VWAP, cumulative VWAP, daily high/low, tick grids, epsilon thresholds, rounded prices, or arithmetic-price distance
including 09:30, lunch, overnight, cross-day, cross-stock, higher-lag, rolling, selected subwindow, morning-only, afternoon-only, or time-weighted pairs
requiring more than one nonzero breakout, changing the denominator, filling a zero denominator, lower-is-better direction, year subsets, filters, thresholds, or combinations with terminal mechanisms
